completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1303_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Kalumboyan in the barrio of Nangka, and the sitio of Balabag in the barrio of Manihihon, Municipality of Bayawan, Province of Oriental Negros are hereby constituted into separate and independent barrios to be known as the barrios of Kalumboyan and Villareal, respectively.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
